description: issue_severity, computed: 1-StructSim(claim.pred, truth.pred) -- the residual between what a disputant claims and what the rulebook-grounded ground truth actually says -- replacing rule_dispute_escalation.json's own caller-supplied scalar with a genuinely derived value, per the user's own diagnosis ('a dispute is the residual between two held beliefs') and CLAUDE.md's SHAPES-NOT-NUMBERS rule (a hand-set scalar knob is unpaid debt). Strictly additive: rule_dispute_escalation.json is NOT edited, reused via its own unchanged has_signal production. Fires ONLY when a genuine residual exists (StructSim<1.0) -- identical beliefs mint no dispute at all, a live correction after finding severity=0.0 does not structurally floor the downstream pressure formula (ambient audience/closeness terms are independent of severity). Zero new Rust -- StructSim, like every other Term this arc has used, pre-existed (runners/dsl/src/term.rs::struct_sim_value), confirmed by direct probe before registering (PREREG Sec1: 0.667 similarity / 0.333 residual on a one-slot contradiction, 1.0/0.0 on identical predications) rather than assumed. v1.1.0 (WIRE_IN_PREREG.md): an optional SelfPattern on the BeliefDisagreement now carries over to the minted DisputeContext, mirroring witness carry-over exactly -- closes the gap that stopped this seed and rule_dispute_self_conscious_bridge.json from composing end to end when a dispute originates from raw beliefs rather than a hand-built DisputeContext. See DISPUTE_SEVERITY_AS_RESIDUAL_PREREG.md / _RESULTS.md and WIRE_IN_PREREG.md.

concepts.name: dispute_severity_as_residual
concepts.definition: A rule dispute's issue_severity is the structural residual between a disputant's claimed belief and the rulebook-grounded ground truth -- 1 minus their StructSim similarity -- not a hand-set scalar. Two identical beliefs produce zero severity structurally; a partial contradiction produces a graded, measured residual.
concepts.why: User: 'A dispute is the residual between two held beliefs' -- a direct correction of rule_dispute_escalation.json's own hand-picked issue_severity input. DISPUTE_SEVERITY_AS_RESIDUAL_PREREG.md.
